headline: Asian Paints sets October 29 for Q2 FY27 earnings and interim dividend review
hook: Upcoming board meet to review earnings and payout
summary: Asian Paints has announced that its board of directors will meet on October 29, 2026, to consider and approve the financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. During the meeting, the board will also evaluate the declaration of an interim dividend for shareholders. The company has fixed November 4 as the record date for the dividend if it is approved. For the previous financial year, the paint manufacturer had distributed a total dividend of Rs 27.50 per share. Retail investors holding the stock ahead of the record date are eligible for the payout if declared.
why_it_matters: Dividend eligibility depends on holding shares before November 4.
